title: Paul McCartney live: Golden 1 Center, Sacramento | 2016
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, California, USA, on 5 October 2016.

It was the 37th show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between September and November 2005, and the second of two consecutive nights in Sacramento.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
